name: jupp
pronunciation_note: Rhineland short form of Josef, said with a German j (like English y) and a short u. Addressed-only (train_bare false): bare 'Jupp'/'jup' is also colloquial for yes in German and sounds like English 'yup', so a bare head would fire on every casual yes, and those spellings are accept_stems, never look-alikes. English synthesis uses the spelling 'Yupp' so TTS does not say an English j as in 'jump'; pending owner listening review. German only (owner, 2026-11-04): nobody addresses 'Jupp' in English, so there is no English head to train, record or publish.
